title: SensitivePaths
description: A target repository's own rules for which changes need particular care, kept at .factorial/sensitive-paths.json. Read from the base branch, never from the branch under review. Each changed file a rule matches gets a high-severity finding from the orchestrator in the review, whatever the reviewer concludes.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this contract. Incremented only for breaking changes.

rules.description: Checked in order after the built-in rules; the first rule a file matches gives its reason.

path.description: A repository-relative file path, matched exactly.

prefix.description: A repository-relative path prefix, such as a directory ending in /.

contentPattern.description: A POSIX extended regular expression, matched against the added and removed lines of each changed file (git diff -G).

reason.description: Completes the sentence "This change ...", for example "changes the IAM roles the service deploys with".
